Download details
Configure connections before downloading. Servers must support HTTP range requests.

Options

Your defaults are saved and reused for every new download.

Read URL from clipboard when adding

When you click Add URL, a valid copied HTTP(S) link fills the URL field automatically.

The clipboard is read only when you open Add URL. No background clipboard monitoring.

Connections per file (default)

Split a supported file into parallel byte-range requests. All new downloads inherit this setting.

Use multiple Internet connections

Use several active IPv4 network adapters for one segmented download. Experimental on real dual-WAN systems.

Network adapters

Choose two or more adapters that actually have separate Internet access. If nothing is checked, all eligible adapters are used.

Each download segment uses its own TCP connection. More connections or adapters don't guarantee faster speeds; network routing and server limits still apply.

Default download folder

Where all downloads go unless you choose a folder for a particular file.

Separate software installers

Store downloaded .exe, .msi, .msix and .appx installers in another folder.

Installer downloads folder

This sets the destination of downloaded installer files. It does not change where programs are installed by Windows.

Simultaneous downloads

How many different files can transfer at once. Jobs start in FIFO order.

Retries per segment

Automatically retry a failed segment before marking the download as failed.

HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 proxy

Optional proxy URL for new transfers. Leave empty to use system environment proxy settings. Credentials are not stored.

Proxy settings apply to future or resumed downloads, not transfers already in progress.

Settings apply to new downloads.

About updates
